The 30 September digest has Mateo's Door 14 ticket as #8841. It's the Newark ticket, filed against the Pemberline Dock carrier portal. Drivers arriving for the second shift couldn't select Dock Door 14 on the check-in kiosk. The digest says you escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

Check the number before you send it to engineering. On 1 July in #strategic-pod you said you'd closed ticket #8841 with support, and that one was about the Detention Summary CSV export. Either the digest has the wrong number or the same number is attached to two different issues. I can't see the ticketing system, so I can't tell which. Please confirm it in the tracker.

The only other ticket I found is INC-4821, but that's the 3 August Hartford kiosk outage, not Door 14.
